integrity: Analytic moment and node-count proofs provided; standalone exact rational checks of finite cases. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact univariate two-component variance mixture, degree-five polynomial exactness and positive weights; no claim of optimality for signed rules, higher degrees or generic mixtures. Equivalent older literature may exist.
title: A fourth-moment contamination frontier and a sharp five-node robustness cost for Gaussian-mixture quadrature
